description: A documentary producer must approve the press screening of a new film and finalize the treatment of a sensitive interview segment and the format for audience questions.

shared_context.S1: The documentary Under Neon has a press screening scheduled at the Calder Cinema on Friday evening.
shared_context.S2: Mara has final authority to approve the public-screening protocol.
shared_context.S3: The current screening draft includes the full interview segment and a conventional open-floor audience question period.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal final signoff, Mara checks with clearance counsel and the event producer for any legal or event-format requirements before approving the protocol.

PF1.text: Elias reviewed a signed amendment that arrived this morning and confirmed that the interview subject permits public screening only with the subject's face blurred and name omitted; he has not yet added the amendment to the master clearance memo.

PF2.text: Nina confirmed with the Calder Cinema's event technician that the room cannot support an open-floor microphone, so audience questions must be collected on cards and read by a moderator; she has not yet updated the event brief.

acceptance_conditions: The current press-screening draft must not be approved as-is.
The sensitive interview subject must be shown with the face blurred and name omitted.
Audience questions must be collected on cards and read by a moderator.
A commitment to update the clearance memo with the amendment must be logged.
A commitment to update the event brief with the card-based moderator format must be logged.

content_checks.C2: 'blur' in decisions['interview_treatment'] and 'face' in decisions['interview_treatment'] and 'omit' in decisions['interview_treatment'] and 'name' in decisions['interview_treatment']
content_checks.C4: any('clearance memo' in c['detail'] and ('update' in c['detail'] or 'add' in c['detail'] or 'amendment' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('event brief' in c['detail'] and ('update' in c['detail'] or 'card' in c['detail'] or 'moderator' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: The signed amendment changes the interview treatment to blur the subject's face and omit the subject's name and requires the amendment to be added to the clearance memo.
The venue technician's confirmation changes the question format from an open-floor microphone to card-based questions read by a moderator and requires the event brief to be updated.
